title: Influence of Surgical Trauma in the Nasal Cavity on the Expression of p53 Protein in the Hippocampus of Rats.
authors: Kastyro, I V; Reshetov, I V; Khamidulin, G V; Shilin, S S; Torshin, V I; Kostyaeva, M G; Popadyuk, V I; Yunusov, T Y; Shmaevsky, P E; Shalamov, K P; Kupryakova, A D; Doroginskaya, E S; Sedelnikova, A D
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨鼻中隔成形术创伤对大鼠海马p53蛋白表达的影响，属于神经生物学与手术应激研究，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: The aim of the study was to determine the role of the stress effect of septoplasty modeling on p53 protein expression in the hippocampus of rats under conditions of sensory olfactory deprivation. Simulation of septoplasty was carried out on 30 sexually mature male rats. A quantitative assessment of the apoptosis of neurons in the pyramidal layer of the hippocampus in the subfields CA1, CA2, CA3, and dentate gyrus (DG) on days 2, 4, and 6 after surgery was carried out. Histological sections were stained by the immunohistochemical method with antibodies to the p53 protein. An increase in the number of p53-positive neurons was noted in all subfields; the maximum increase in the number of apoptotic neurons was noted on day 4 after surgery. The stress effect of modeling septoplasty in rats, accompanied by sensory deprivation of the peripheral part of the olfactory analyzer, provoked the expression of p53 and the initiation of apoptosis mechanisms in various subfields of the hippocampus.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨感觉嗅觉剥夺条件下，鼻中隔成形术建模的应激效应对大鼠海马中p53蛋白表达的作用。实验在30只性成熟雄性大鼠上进行了鼻中隔成形术模拟。术后第2、4、6天，对海马锥体层CA1、CA2、CA3亚区及齿状回（DG）中神经元凋亡进行了定量评估。组织切片采用免疫组织化学方法，用p53蛋白抗体进行染色。在所有亚区中均观察到p53阳性神经元数量增加；凋亡神经元数量最大增加出现在术后第4天。建模鼻中隔成形术的应激效应，伴随嗅觉分析器外周部分的感觉剥夺，激发了大鼠海马各亚区中p53的表达及凋亡机制的启动。
